湄公河为什么被称为"亚洲的多瑙河"？

Why is the Mekong called "the Danube of Asia"?

它流经六国、滋养着巨大的三角洲与渔场，是数千万人的血脉；同一条河串起多国生态与生计，重要性堪比多瑙河在欧洲的角色。
Flowing through six countries and feeding a vast delta and fisheries, it's the lifeline for tens of millions—one river tying many nations' ecology and livelihoods, like the Danube in Europe.

湄公河上游建水坝，为什么会让下游渔获减少？

Why do upstream Mekong dams reduce downstream fish catches?

大坝阻断了鱼类洄游通道，并改变了天然的洪枯节律；下游依赖涨水繁殖的鱼类少了"信号"，渔获随之下降，影响千万人的餐桌。
Dams block migration and flatten the natural flood-pulse; fish that breed on rising water lose their cue, so catches fall—affecting millions of dinner tables.

湄公河三角洲为什么在"下沉"？

Why is the Mekong Delta "sinking"?

上游水坝拦截泥沙、三角洲过度抽取地下水，地面沉降速度超过海平面上升；原本靠泥沙补给的平原失去"进补"，海水倒灌随之加剧。
Upstream dams trap sediment while excessive groundwater pumping causes subsidence faster than sea-level rise; the plain loses its sediment "top-up," worsening seawater intrusion.
